items.q: I asked Roy Zimmerman about him thinking he might be

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Roy remember the ragtime contest. Oh, yeah, for White Sonley. Isn't that funny? 1914, Leclerc and Kid Ross among the entrants. Isn't that something?
